text:
What does it actually mean to have faith — and
how do you know if yours is real?

Is doubt a sign of weak faith or a normal part of
it? What does Scripture say?

Why does God allow suffering — and how do you
hold that alongside believing He is good?

What does it mean to fear God — and why does the
Bible say that’s the beginning of wisdom?

Is it possible to believe in God intellectually
but not actually trust Him? What’s the difference?

What does the Bible actually say about heaven —
and does your picture of it match that?

Why did Jesus have to die — couldn’t God have
just forgiven people without the cross?

What does the Bible say about identity — who are
you, really, when everything else is stripped away?

What is repentance — actually? Is it just feeling
bad, or is there more to it?

Can a man really change, or is character mostly
fixed? What does Scripture say about transformation?

What does the Bible say about anger — when is it
right and when does it become sin?

What is pride in Scripture — and why does God
oppose it so strongly?

What does the Bible say about rest — and why do
most men treat it as laziness?

What does the Bible actually say about what it
means for a man to lead in a relationship or family?

What does Scripture say about forgiveness — does
forgiving someone mean trusting them again?

What does the Bible say about the tongue — and
why does it get so much attention in Proverbs and James?

What does it mean to honor your father and
mother as an adult — when they’re not always right?

What does the Bible say about conflict — how are
believers supposed to handle it when relationships break down?

What does the Bible say about wealth — is money
itself a problem, or is it something else?

What does Scripture say about work — is it a
curse after the fall, or was it always part of the plan?

What does the Bible say about ambition — is
there a version of it that’s God-honoring?

What does Scripture say about generosity — and
what’s the relationship between giving and faith?

What does the Bible say about contentment — and
how do you actually get there?

Does God still speak today — and if so, how?
What does Scripture say about hearing from God?

What is the Holy Spirit actually doing in a
believer’s life day to day — what does that look like practically?

What does the Bible say about prayer — does it
change things, or does God do what He’s going to do anyway?

What does it mean to read the Bible well — how
do you study it rather than just read it?

What does the Bible say about church — is it
optional for a believer, or is it essential?

What does the Bible say about hell — and does
your honest view of it affect how you live and talk about faith?

Is Jesus really the only way — what does
Scripture say, and how do you hold that in a pluralistic world?
